items.exampleEn: She used a red dye to change the color of her hair.
items.exampleZh: 她用紅色染劑改變了頭髮的顏色。

items.exampleEn: The meeting went on without interruption for three hours.
items.exampleZh: 會議不間斷地開了三個小時。

items.exampleEn: The refrain of this song is easy to remember.
This reprint of the old map costs much less than the original.
items.exampleZh: 這張舊地圖的翻印本比原版便宜得多。

items.exampleEn: He built a small replica of the Eiffel Tower out of sticks.
items.exampleZh: 他用木棍做了一個艾菲爾鐵塔的小型複製品。

items.exampleEn: He hastily packed his bag and ran to the station.
items.exampleZh: 他匆忙收好行李，跑去車站。

items.exampleEn: Her voice faltered as she began her speech.
items.exampleZh: 她開始演講時，聲音有些顫抖、結巴。

items.exampleEn: Nature bestowed great beauty on this small island.
items.exampleZh: 大自然賦予這座小島極美的景色。

items.sentenceEn: The children sang the refrain of the song again and again.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們一遍又一遍地唱那首歌的副歌。

items.audioEn: The first printing sold out in a week, so a reprint will be ready next month.
items.audioZh: 第一刷一週就賣完了，所以再版下個月會出來。

items.sentenceEn: He answered the phone hastily and forgot to say who he was.
items.sentenceZh: 他匆匆接起電話，忘了說自己是誰。

items.sentenceEn: The runner faltered near the end but still finished the race.
items.sentenceZh: 那位跑者快到終點時腳步不穩，但還是跑完了比賽。

items.stemEn: Visitors can sit inside a ____ of the first plane ever built.
items.stemZh: 遊客可以坐進世界第一架飛機的複製品裡。

items.stemEn: The king ____ a medal on the brave young soldier.
items.stemZh: 國王授予那位勇敢的年輕士兵一枚獎章。

items.passageEn: Our town museum has a special room about printing. It shows a replica of a printing machine from five hundred years ago, and the artistry of early printers is clear on the old pages beside it. A worker colors the pages with natural dye made from leaves. My favorite item was a reprint of the town's first newspaper, which you can buy at the gift shop. During our visit, there was a short interruption when the fire alarm rang by mistake, but everyone soon came back.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮的博物館有一間介紹印刷的特別展室。裡面展示一台五百年前印刷機的複製品，從旁邊展示的舊書頁就看得出早期印刷工人的技藝。一位工作人員用樹葉做的天然染料替紙張上色。我最喜歡的展品是本鎮第一份報紙的翻印本，在禮品店就買得到。我們參觀時，火災警報誤響，參觀中斷了一下，不過大家很快就回來了。

questions.questionZh: 作者最喜歡哪一件展品？
參觀為什麼中斷了一下？

items.promptZh: 比賽因為下雨中斷了半小時。
referenceEn: Because of the rain, there was a thirty-minute interruption in the game.
The rain caused an interruption of half an hour in the game.
rubricZh: 要用 interruption 當名詞（例如 an interruption in the game）
「半小時」可寫，例如 thirty minutes、half an hour 等
時態合理即可（例如 was、caused 等）

items.promptZh: 她匆忙寫了一張字條就出門了。
referenceEn: She hastily wrote a note and left the house.
She wrote a note hastily and went out.
rubricZh: hastily 修飾動詞，可放動詞前或後（例如 hastily wrote、wrote … hastily 等）
「出門」可寫，例如 left the house、went out 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 wrote、has left 等）
